winner.title: Nepalese Style Dhal Bhat Recipe

evidence.authenticity: Moong dal with freshly ground whole-spice masala (cinnamon, cardamom, clove, chili, pepper, cumin) fried with onion, the Nepali-style dal approach; author is an Indian recipe site, not Nepali; no regional context; rice and tarkari not covered, only a serving suggestion
evidence.precision: Volumes only (2 cups dal, spices by tsp); no water amount, no rice recipe, no weights; cues are weak ('soft and mushy', 'onions translucent', 'raw smell goes away'); 0 temperatures
evidence.testing: Rating 4.9 from 19,023 ratings shows heavy real-world use; no explanation of why
evidence.photos: 6 step images in schema, one per step
evidence.efficiency: 40 minutes total, no wasted steps; dal pressure-cooked while spices ground
evidence.access: All items at a US grocery or Indian aisle; split yellow moong is common

winner.why: Best step photos and the largest rating base among the dal-only recipes, though still under the 60 bar for lack of precision and a full meal.

runnerUp.title: Dal Bhat Tarkari (Nepali Rice, Lentils & Vegetable Curry)

evidence.authenticity: Covers the whole meal: rice, red lentil dal, tarkari and gundruk pickle; gundruk is the genuinely Nepali touch; the dal text is near-identical to International Cuisine's recipe
evidence.precision: 14 ingredients with grams or ml; rice water ratios given; cues mostly 'until soft'; pressure-cooker dal timed in whistles; no pan sizes
evidence.photos: No step images in schema; 53 images on page not confirmed as process shots
evidence.efficiency: 85 minutes; method I/II rice options add clutter; gundruk needs a week
evidence.access: Mustard and turnip leaves for gundruk are harder to find; no substitutes

runnerUp.why: Most complete and most Nepali meal, but it is thinly tested and has few cues or process photos.

companions.title: Dal Bhat Tarkari (Nepalese vegetable curry with lentil soup and rice)
companions.why: Gives volume amounts, a doneness cue for the onion and vegetables, and a rice method; no step photos.

searches: authentic Nepali dal bhat tarkari achar recipe Nepali food blog jimbu dal
notes: No Serious Eats, NYT or ATK recipe for Nepali dal bhat exists; the sites search returned only Indian dals. No candidate came from a Nepali author, and no page gives weights plus real doneness cues. Many pages recycle the same red lentil recipe. A retry might look for a Nepali-authored blog or cookbook excerpt (jimbu, gundruk, ghee tarka). Not all candidates read were fully scored: the lower scores for International Cuisine, My Cooking Journey and Bossy Kitchen are quick estimates.
